dedupe_keys.name: processed origin destination inland waterway transport flows monthly number of teus and water level conditions in the rhine alpine corridor

description: Felipe Bedoya-Maya publishes processed origin-destination inland-waterway flows, monthly container volumes and water-level conditions for the Rhine-Alpine Corridor. Zenodo serves processed and original-file ZIPs, a Stata processing script and a short README under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The README says the script cleans and structures source datasets for descriptive and statistical work, while the page title identifies monthly TEU and water-level variables. These inputs can test freight rerouting or throughput sensitivity to low-water disruption in inland-shipping simulations. A related catalogue record, the Rhine-Alpine 50-year freight series, is an annual country-level resource, not these corridor origin-destination and water-level files. A limitation is that the public README gives no observation years, route resolution or units beyond the title. Original sources are documented separately and must be checked before transfer to another corridor. Neither archive was downloaded, and flow totals were not reconciled.
